<thought>We will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that matches the intramolecular carbonyl‑ene reaction. The target molecule is represented by the SMILES “C1CCCCC1C(=O)C=CC”. The reaction breaks a ketone (C=O) and a C=C double bond, forms a new C‑C single bond, and creates an aliphatic hydroxyl group. Using the correct bond format (“6-6” for C‑C single bonds, “6-8” for C‑O, “6-6” for C=C), we query the template catalog.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C1CCCCC1C(=O)C=CC",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "bonds_broken": ["6-8", "6-6"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
